# The Lore of Dark Magic

*Page PDF 8*

THE CORSAIRS OF CAPTAIN FL ARIEL 

## **The Lore of Dark Magic**
The sorceresses of the Dark Covenant are a dark mirror of Asur spellcasters. They too have mastered the Winds of Magic, yet their sorcery has no restraint. They weave spells from pure dark energy, with greater finesse than Human dabblers in the arcane. 

Any target who takes damage from a Lore of Dark Magic spell experiences the sorceress’s vicious spite. In addition to Overcasting, any success with 3+ SL over the CN inflicts 2 x SL additional hits to the Body Hit Location with Damage equal to the base CN of the spell that ignores Armour Points. 

The following spells provide a taste of the Lore of Dark Magic — a complete list will follow in future supplements. These examples are chiefly combat spells, but Dark Magic encompasses much more than overt violence. 

## **Arnzipal’s Black Horror**
**CN:** 13 

**Range:** Willpower yards (or Random Vortex) **Target:** AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) **Duration:** Willpower Bonus Rounds 

## **Shroud of Despair**
## **Cn:** 8
**Range:** Willpower yards **Target:** AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) **Duration:** Willpower Bonus Rounds 

The sorceress tears the veil between reality and the Aethyr, and a black cloud of roiling energy sweeps across the land, trailing slimy tentacles that drag unfortunate victims to an unknown fate. All who fall within the Area of Effect must take a **Difficult (–10) Strength** Test or suffer 3 Wounds. Those who Fumble the Strength Test must spend a Fate Point or are dragged into the Aethyr, which costs them their lives. The vortex moves 1d10 + 5 yards in a random direction each Turn — use the _random vortex_ rules from **Winds of Magic** pages 20–21 if available, otherwise determine the direction randomly as you see fit. 

## **Doombolt**
**CN:** 7 **Range:** Willpower yards **Target:** 1 **Duration:** Instant 

The sorceress invokes the name of an otherworldly beast and unleashes its blasphemous energy as a bolt of pure darkness. This is a _magic missile_ with Damage +8, increased by +4 if the caster passes an optional **Hard (–20) Language (Magick)** Test. Failure in this additional Test causes a roll on the Major Miscast Table. 

The sorceress gestures with elaborate movements to bring a pall of gloom to engulf her enemies. Suffocating darkness suffuses all targets within the Area of Effect, sapping their will and energy. They suffer from 1 _Fatigued_ Condition for every SL from the casting roll and unless they pass a **Challenging (–0) Cool** Test, they gain a Broken Condition. 

## **Word of Pain**
**CN:** 7 

**Range:** Willpower yards **Target:** AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) **Duration:** Willpower Bonus Rounds 

As the sorceress utters a forbidden name, the bodies of her enemies bend and buckle, wracked with waves of agony. Targets within the Area of Effect must pass a **Difficult (–10) Cool** Test, subtracting any SL from the casting roll to the result. If they fail, reduce all Melee or Ranged Tests they make by the same SL.
